suite.description:
Checks that every value converter Skyve offers shows, accepts and filters values the same way a user would expect, in PrimeFaces (tablet) and in SmartClient. Each group of converters (dates, date times, timestamps, date times and timestamps shown only as dates, times, and numbers) has a script per renderer.
Each script types a few records into every field and into an inline grid row, as a user would type them, and checks the values after the save and again after reopening the record. It then filters the list by each column, with values written as the cells show them, and checks which rows each filter leaves. The values are chosen to catch the usual mistakes: a day and month swapped, times at noon, midnight and PM, rounding, negatives, percentages and durations.
A pass means a user sees, enters and finds the same value in either renderer, whatever converter a field uses.
